maya: Orion Biotech needs dedicated migration. They require model pin v2.7.2-fp16 and runtime redwood/runtime:2026-04-28-stable. Asking for 2026-05-02 22:00-23:30 UTC window (Sat night).
nathan: LAX cluster has capacity but we need slice reservation + priming. I'll book slice-3 and include 30m buffer.
olga: Note: last migration saw tokenization drift — add a token-alignment smoke before ramp.
pete: Customer wants 5% canary for 20m, then a manual hold. If hold OK, 50% for 10m then 100%. Manual CS signoff required at 5% and 50%.
qasim: Proposed rollback gates: sustained error-rate >1.0% over 5m OR p95 > 3x baseline OR inference-mismatch >1% on smoke checks -> immediate rollback.
maya: Runbook steps in thread: reserve slice, priming, deploy canary 5%, run token-alignment smoke, wait for CS signoff, ramp to 50% then 100%, post-rollout smoke to s3://orion/reports/postcheck.json. Pin metadata: model=v2.7.2-fp16 commit=cc9d2a, runtime=redwood/runtime:2026-04-28-stable.
nathan: Reservation done: slice-3 reserved LAX 2026-05-02T22:00Z-23:45Z (includes buffer). Reservation ID R-99123. Priming job queued.
deploybot: priming job queued id=701002 for tenant orion slice=3 model=v2.7.2-fp16. ETA 7m.
nathan: Priming logs: `priming: 100/100 samples, avg 48ms, token_cov 97%`.
olga: I'll wire synthetic correctness checks to the canary and post results here.
maya: Approvals needed: CS, infra, SRE, release-manager. Please respond approve/hold within 45m.
pete: CS: approve, will perform manual signoff at holds.
nathan: Infra: approve. :thumbsup:
olga: SRE: approve for canary + monitoring hooks. Added alert for mismatch rate.
qasim: Release manager: approve. Filing release note RN-2026-05-02-orion.
maya: Rollback command for runbook:
```
deploybot rollback --tenant orion --slice 3 --to-model v2.7.1 --force
```
qasim: Billing note created: ticket B-88190.
maya: Locking window and will post runbook to #eng-oncall 1h prior. Any objections?
nathan: approve
olga: approve
